cause: Consumer startup loaded the entire manifest and built a second canonical serialization before Kafka connection, causing large transient memory alongside the long-lived worker. A large-sale consumer was OOMKilled under its unchanged 256 MiB limit.

proof.scope: Separate fresh host processes on the exact live synthetic manifest; total peak RSS, not consumer cgroup high-water.
